snippet.title: It's gameplay from A Game About Typing The Alphabet
snippet.description:
It's gameplay from A Game About Typing The Alphabet.

Type the alphabet as fast as possible. Even the slightest mistake will reset the game, and you have to start over. How fast can you type? Climb the leaderboard and become the master of typing.

Homepage: https://www.agameabouttypingthealphabet.com?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description
Leaderboard: https://leaderboard.agameabouttypingthealphabet.com?utm_source=youtube.com&utm_medium=description
